#!/bin/bash

# Network Monitoring Script
# Pings 8.8.8.8 every 60 seconds and logs connectivity status

LOG_FILE="/workspace/network_log.txt"
TARGET_HOST="8.8.8.8"
PING_COUNT=2
PING_TIMEOUT=5

# Ensure log file exists
touch "$LOG_FILE"

# Log script startup
echo "[$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')] INFO - Network monitoring started (target: $TARGET_HOST)" >> "$LOG_FILE"

while true; do
    TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

    # Ping target host
    if ping -c "$PING_COUNT" -W "$PING_TIMEOUT" "$TARGET_HOST" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] UP - Successfully reached $TARGET_HOST" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    else
        echo "[$TIMESTAMP] DOWN - Failed to reach $TARGET_HOST" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    fi

    # Wait 60 seconds before next check
    sleep 60
done
